03 / USE THE LOCKED PREDICTOR

Your proteins.
The same fixed recipe.

Run locally with a complete protein FASTA. Feature extraction uses the pinned CUDA FP16 ProtT5 encoder; cached raw-feature inference can run on CPU.

QUICK START / COMMAND LINE
python -m pip install -e .
bacrootfit assets --from-dir ../assets
bacrootfit download-encoder --encoder-dir resources/prott5
bacrootfit predict --fasta proteins.faa \
  --encoder-dir resources/prott5 \
  --model-dir models/deployment --out predictions.tsv

Install the CUDA encoder dependencies described in the repository. Downloaded model artifacts are verified before use. The website provides data browsing; prediction executes locally.

Match the model to the question.

04 / METHODS & ATTRIBUTION

Keep the evidence
in the picture.

The model prioritizes candidates from sequence. Its labels remain tied to genetic perturbations and their original experimental settings.

Data and partitions

The formal database is v0.12 with repaired V27 homology groups. The internal test contains 2,841 proteins. All development folds and neural-monitor partitions are frozen. Parent-graph bridge sequences are not additional training negatives.

Control filtering preserves tested, source-qualified records with finite eligible effects within the recorded 0.8–1.2 point-effect band. This is not an equivalence test.

H3 is a transfer phenotype

Aquitalea magnusonii H3 was measured on duckweed surfaces. It is provided separately as a historical surface-colonization transfer cohort, not as root-specific training data or a newly blind external study.
